no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-triviagenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Trivia Generator is a trivia and quiz API that serves random trivia questions complete with multiple-choice options and the correct answer. Paid plans can filter questions across topics like history, science, geography, and pop culture.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-translator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Translator is a language translation API that translates written text into target languages using standard language codes. Submit any string with a target language code to receive the translated text and the confirmed or auto-detected source language.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-texttocolor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text to Color converts natural language color names into hexadecimal color codes. Send descriptive color phrases to receive matching hex values and channel counts, with paid plans adding RGB, HSL, and CMYK formats.

no_pyproject_toml.name: lambdadb
no_pyproject_toml.summary: The Official LambdaDB Python SDK.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-timezonelookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Timezone Lookup resolves any city or IANA zone name to its local time, UTC offset, and calendar date. Responses include 12-hour and 24-hour clocks plus the minute offset from GMT.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-titlecaseconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Title Case Converter formats text strings into specific editorial style guidelines and capitalization standards. Send raw headline text and a chosen rule set like APA, Chicago, or AP to receive properly capitalized copy.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-thesaurus
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Thesaurus finds synonyms and alternative terms for any word. Supply a single target word to receive an array of matching synonyms.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textsummarizer
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Summarizer condenses raw text into concise summaries of a specified sentence count. Pass up to 5,000 characters to extract key points into readable summaries, with paid plans adding word counts and reduction metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: dcert
no_pyproject_toml.summary: MCP server for TLS certificate analysis via the Model Context Protocol

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textlanguage
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Language is a language detection API that detects the language of any input string, returning the full language name and its two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Send plain text passages or short snippets to identify incoming multilingual content.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textsimilarity
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Similarity compares two text strings and calculates their percentage match score. It returns case-insensitive and case-sensitive similarity scores plus the count and proportion of differing words.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-tenseconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Tense Converter rewrites text into past or future tense. Submit any passage with your chosen target tense to receive the transformed wording and a flag indicating whether the text changed.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-streetaddressparser
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components. Pass any single-line address string to extract the building number, street name, street type, city, state abbreviation, and postal code.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-swiftcodelookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: SWIFT Code Lookup identifies the bank institution, branch, city, and country code behind any SWIFT or BIC code. Search by code or query by bank name to verify matching financial institutions and branch locations.

no_pyproject_toml.name: django-safe-template-engine
no_pyproject_toml.summary: A Django template engine to render untrusted template code

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-stockmarketopentimes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Stock Market Open Times checks if a global stock exchange is currently trading and provides its opening and closing times. Pass an exchange code like NYSE or LSE to get current open status, official exchange name, and session hours.
